features.label: Structural Path Randomization
features.quickpls_scope: Single-model Freedman-Lane structural path randomization under documented fixed-score linear nuisance assumptions.
known_differences: This is single-model structural-score path randomization, not multigroup analysis, MGA, or MICOM.
The original converged PLS construct scores and measurement solution remain fixed; the measurement model is not re-estimated for each permutation.

Pathwise plus-one probabilities are unadjusted for multiplicity and assume exchangeable reduced-model residuals; qualification calibration is limited to paired homoscedastic Gaussian constant-variance scenarios and does not establish heteroskedastic or broader non-Gaussian validity.

features.label: Binary Logistic Regression
features.quickpls_scope: Binary logistic maximum-likelihood regression with an intercept, exact numeric 0/1 complete-case outcome profiling, numeric predictors and controls, deterministic Newton-IRLS, Wald inference, odds ratios, probabilities, classification diagnostics, and likelihood fit statistics.
known_differences: The first bounded native release fixes two-sided 95% Wald inference, a 0.5 classification threshold, 100 IRLS iterations, a 1e-8 stopping tolerance, and one worker instead of exposing every SmartPLS calculation option.
Automatic categorical encoding, multinomial or ordinal outcomes, survey or case weights, clustered covariance, Firth or penalized estimation, and copied SmartPLS project files are not supported.

features.label: Regression Bootstrapping
features.quickpls_scope: Deterministic indexed case resampling for supported OLS and binary logistic coefficients, with a fixed two-sided 95% standard-normal bootstrap-ratio test, percentile-primary intervals, conditional BCa intervals, progress, cancellation, persistence, and native export.
known_differences: QuickPLS uses a fixed seed and deterministic indexed worker-invariant streams; it does not claim numerical identity with SmartPLS random-number generation.

The first bounded slice fixes two-sided 95% inference, excludes studentized intervals and custom alpha/tail settings, and reports BCa as unavailable with a reason when delete-one acceleration is not estimable.
OLS and binary logistic evidence is qualified separately within the dedicated packaged report; generic PLS bootstrapping is never substituted for this feature.

features.label: Graph-defined Path Analysis and PROCESS
features.quickpls_scope: Independently implemented graph-defined continuous-outcome OLS path analysis with parallel and serial mediation, continuous or exact-0/1 moderation, bounded moderated mediation, conditional effects, HC3 and Student-t inference, simple slopes, Johnson-Neyman regions, and optional dedicated percentile and conditional-BCa case bootstrap without copied numbered macros.
known_differences: Historical regression_process_v1 output is archive-readable only and is not accepted as current v2 execution or qualification evidence.
QuickPLS authors equivalent relationships visually and does not copy proprietary numbered PROCESS templates, source code, or SmartPLS project files.

The bounded v2 contract excludes binary endogenous equations, weights and clusters, broader categorical coding, intermediate or multiple moderated stages on one indirect path, studentized intervals, custom tails or alpha levels, and graphs beyond the documented caps.
